<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Second Libyan Civil War]]; [[Libya-Sudan relations]]
**[[Sudanese Armed Forces|Sudanese forces]] arrest about 160 people on [[Libya–Sudan border|the border]] with [[Libya]] who were en-route to enter the neighboring country to operate as "[[mercenaries]]". A General for the [[Rapid Support Forces]] says that "sending Sudanese to fight in Libya as mercenaries is unacceptable". [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2020/07/19/Sudan-forces-arrest-160-mercenaries-en-route-to-Libya.html (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
****[[Hong Kong]] records its highest one-day increase in cases since the [[COVID-19 pandemic|pandemic]] began, with 108 new cases, including 83 local transmission cases and 25 imported cases. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-53462362 (BBC News)]
****[[Hong Kong Chief Executive|Chief Executive]] [[Carrie Lam]] announces new measures including plans to make it compulsory to wear masks inside any public indoor venue and a new order for non-essential [[civil servant]]s to work from home. [https://www.france24.com/en/20200719-hong-kong-leader-says-coronavirus-critical-after-100-new-cases (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports its highest one-day increase in [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] deaths and recoveries, with 127 new deaths bringing the nationwide death toll to 4,143, and 2,133 new recoveries bringing the nationwide number of recoveries to 45,401. [https://health.detik.com/berita-detikhealth/d-5099704/2-rekor-corona-di-indonesia-pasien-sembuh-dan-meninggal-terbanyak-per-19-juli (detikHealth)]  [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-indonesia-cases/indonesia-reports-1639-new-coronavirus-cases-and-127-deaths-idUSKCN24K0AX (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Texas]]
****[[List of governors of Texas|Texas Governor]] [[Greg Abbott]] announces that five [[United States Navy]] teams would be deployed to hospitals in [[Harlingen, Texas|Harlingen]], [[Del Rio, Texas|Del Rio]], [[Eagle Pass, Texas|Eagle Pass]], and [[Rio Grande City, Texas|Rio Grande City]]. [https://www.texastribune.org/2020/07/19/texas-coronavirus-hot-spots-navy-rio-grande-valley/ (''Texas Tribune'')]

;International relations
*[[Israel–European Union relations]]
**The [[Israeli government]] approves the subsea [[EastMed pipeline]] which will supply [[Europe]] with [[Natural gas pipeline|natural gas]]. The construction of the pipeline is expected to be completed by 2025, and will provide an estimated 10 billion [[cubic meter]]s of gas per year. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-israel-europe-natgas/israel-approves-pipeline-deal-to-sell-gas-to-europe-idUKKCN24K0FJ?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[George Floyd protests]]
**[[George Floyd protests in Oregon]]
***[[George Floyd protests in Portland, Oregon|George Floyd protests in Portland]]
****[[Mayor of Portland, Oregon|Portland Mayor]] [[Ted Wheeler]] renews calls for federal troops to leave the city, accusing them of "using abusive tactics against protesters." [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-53466718 (BBC News)]
*[[2019–2020 Iranian protests]], [[Capital punishment in Iran]]
**[[Iran]] halts the execution of three young men who were sentenced to death for taking part in anti-[[government of Iran|government]] protests last year. Their lawyer says a request for a new trial was accepted by the [[Supreme Court of Iran|Supreme Court]] after a [[StopExecutionsinIran|hashtag]] against their executions went viral. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-53463685 (BBC News)]
*An [[Algeria]]n man in [[Antwerp]], [[Belgium]], dies after a [[law enforcement in Belgium|police officer]] knelt on his back during an arrest outside a bar. The death was compared to [[killing of George Floyd|that of]] [[George Floyd]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-53478230 (BBC News)]
*Officials in [[Sierra Leone]] report that four protesters, looking to block the movement of a power generator to another town, were killed in the city of [[Makeni]] in Saturday's protests after both [[Sierra Leone Police|police]] and [[Republic of Sierra Leone Armed Forces|soldiers]] opened fire on them. The [[government of Sierra Leone|government]] had acknowledged "potential loss of life" but had not provided details. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-leone-protests/four-killed-in-sierra-leone-protest-after-police-and-army-open-fire-idUSKCN24K0GV?il=0 (Reuters)]
*A shooting at the home of [[United States federal judge|U.S. District Judge]] [[Esther Salas]] leaves her son dead and her husband injured. Salas herself is not injured. Law enforcement officials say the gunman was dressed in a [[FedEx]] uniform. [https://apnews.com/fecbf88ebc2b33e35c291a43ad52939a (AP)] [https://www.cnn.com/2020/07/19/us/federal-judge-esther-salas-shooting-investigation/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Syrian parliamentary election]]
**[[Syrians]] head to the polls to elect 250 seats of [[Parliament of Syria|parliament]]. It is expected that [[President of Syria|President]] [[Bashar al-Assad]] and his party will win most seats. It is also the first time the elections are being held in areas formerly controlled by anti-Assad forces. [https://www.dw.com/en/syria-holds-parliamentary-elections-amid-new-sanctions-crippling-economy/a-54230462 (DW)]
*[[Kuwait]]'s ruler, [[Emir of Kuwait|Emir]] [[Sabah Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah]], 91, undergoes successful surgery and medical treatment. Crown Prince [[Nawaf Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah]], who is 83, temporarily assumes some of the powers and will maintain such powers until "the health event is over". [https://apnews.com/27604a5745ee5b6adfd23bf11c967476 (AP)]

;Science and technology
*[[Emirates Mars Mission]]
**[[Mitsubishi Heavy Industries]] successfully launches ''Hope'', a [[United Arab Emirates]] [[space probe]] to [[Mars]], from [[Tanegashima Space Center]] in [[Japan]]. It is the first mission to Mars from the [[Arab world]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/uae-mars-mission-hope-spacecraft-japan-space-a9627481.html (''The Independent'')]
